Run an optimization function multiple times in parallel

Source: R/fct_parallel_optim.R
parallel_optim.Rd

Wrapper that executes any optim_* function repeatedly and collects the results.

Usage

parallel_optim(
  FUN,
  args,
  runs = 10L,
  cores = 1L,
  seed = NULL,
  stop_conv = FALSE,
  progress_mode = "console"
)

Arguments

FUN

Function. One of optim_vec, optim_mlr, or optim_aov.

args

List. Named arguments forwarded to FUN. progress_mode is silently forced to "off" inside workers.

runs

Integer. Number of independent replications. Default 10.

cores

Integer. Number of parallel workers. Default 1 (sequential). Values > 1 require the future and future.apply packages.

seed

Integer or NULL. If non-NULL, a reproducible seed is generated per run. Default NULL.

stop_conv

Logical. If TRUE, stop launching further runs as soon as one run has converged, i.e. its best_error is below the convergence threshold. Default FALSE.

progress_mode

Character: "console", "shiny", or "off". Controls the outer progress bar only; individual runs always execute silently. Default "console".

Value

An object of class stats2data_parallel — a list with:

results

List of completed runs. Each element is the object returned by FUN (class stats2data_vec, stats2data_mlr, or stats2data_aov).

best

The single result with the lowest best_error.

module

Character. One of "vec", "mlr", or "aov", inferred from the class of the first result.

runs

Integer. Number of runs actually completed.

runs_requested

Integer. Number of runs requested via runs.

converged

Logical. TRUE if a converged run triggered early stopping.

thresh

Numeric or NULL. Threshold used to judge convergence.

Details

When cores > 1, a multisession plan is set up and torn down automatically. Any pre-existing future plan is restored on exit.

With stop_conv = TRUE and cores > 1, runs are dispatched in batches of cores and the convergence check happens after each batch. Up to cores - 1 runs may therefore complete after the first converged run; they are kept in results. With stop_conv = FALSE all runs are dispatched in a single call, as before.

Convergence of a single run is judged as best_error < thresh. For stats2data_vec results, where best_error is a list of per-variable errors, every component must be below thresh.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Parallel ANOVA runs
res <- parallel_optim(
  FUN  = optim_aov,
  args = list(S = 30, levels = c(2, 2), ...),
  runs = 20, cores = 4
)
summary(res)

# Stop as soon as one run converges
res <- parallel_optim(
  FUN  = optim_mlr,
  args = list(N = 100, thresh = 1e-3, ...),
  runs = 20, cores = 4, stop_conv = TRUE
)
} # }
